units.source_text: 日本人称兰草为“藤袴”，称丧服为“藤衣”，故用兰草暗示丧服。

en.t: The Japanese call thoroughwort “fujibakama” and mourning clothes “fuji-goromo,” so the plant is used to suggest mourning dress.
The title of this chapter is based on this.

units.source_text: 兰草是菊科植物，初秋开淡紫色花。

en.t: Thoroughwort is a plant of the aster family, and in early autumn it blooms with pale purple flowers.
